name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration and royalty company focused entirely on the state of Nevada. The company holds a portfolio of properties and royalty interests including a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement at the Lapon Canyon project, along with the Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar gold properties. The company is at the exploration stage, with its most recent reverse circulation drill program completed at Lapon Canyon in 2025.
